title: Tolerance Limits and Cure Refund Period for the Mortgage Loan File
content:
For the Mortgage Loan File, the 10 percent aggregate tolerance bucket and the period for refunding a tolerance cure after consummation are fixed per program as follows.

| Program | Aggregate tolerance allowed on the 10 percent bucket | Calendar days after consummation to refund a cure not credited at closing |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 10.00% | 60 |

The 10 percent bucket groups recording fees and shoppable services chosen from Larkspur's written provider list. The tolerance is stated as a percentage to 2 decimals; the refund period is a whole number of calendar days.

Hypothetical illustration: on a 10 percent bucket of 2000.00 USD, a tolerance of 10.00 percent corresponds to 200.00 USD, so the bucket increased by that tolerance stands at 2200.00 USD. A refund period of 60 calendar days counted from a hypothetical consummation on the 1st of a 31-day month ends on the 2nd of the following month (day zero being the consummation date).
